name: LetGoYourMind – Bedford, NH (One Church - Bedford Outpost)
description_short: A weekly LEGO STEM day program at One Church - Bedford Outpost. Ages 4-5 come for a morning of simple motorized LEGO builds (9am-12pm), and ages 6-13 come 9am-3pm for LEGO building, coding or EV3 robotics, stop-motion animation and, for ages 9-13, Minecraft commands.
activities: LEGO stop-motion animation and film editing

sessions.name: Week of August 2, 2027 (marked * on the site)

sources.note: Bedford, NH has a single ZIP code, 03110 (USPS ZIP lookup by city); the camp names the town but gives no street address

refund_policy_summary: Cancel in writing (email is fine) by April 30; no cancellations are accepted after May 1. A cancellation gets a credit toward next summer, less a $99 non-refundable fee. Cancellations 14 days before the session get a credit of 50% of tuition.

source.title: STEM LEGO & Robotics Summer Program | LetGoYourMind | Bedford, NH|nh, bedford

warnings: Filled zip 03110: Bedford has one ZIP code (2020 Census)
The only address on the page (785 NH-3A Bow, NH 03304) is the company's contact address in Bow, not the Bedford camp site, so it was not used as the camp's address.
The page lists four 2027 weeks and five programs but doesn't say which program runs which week. The ages for each week depend on that, so they were left blank.
The footer copyright says 2025, but the session dates are for 2027.
The registration link goes to one specific UltraCamp session (idsession=433465) and may not cover every week.
